cousin of CMY

Second daughter of the Rev.

Duke Yonge and Charlotte Pode, she married (20 Oct 1898) Frank George Layton.

She was addressed as Dorothy; her children were Monica Yonge Layton (b 1899) and Ronald Layton (b. 1901).
